newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Anergen initiated as a buy. [CORRECTED 23:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Anergen initiated as a buy. [CORRECTED 23:10 GMT]

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc Wednesday initiated coverage of Anergen Inc with a long-term "buy" rating.

-- Vector said Anergen has the potential to become a formidable player in the autoimmune disease arena because of its unique treatment approach, large market opportunities and a $60-million market capitalization.
--Vector said it does not expect Anergen to be profitable within the next five years (corrects from 12 to 18 months), which is Vector's traditional investment horizon.
-- Anergen is a biotechnology company focusing on autoimmune disease treatments.
